stories.title: Trump lands in Beijing ahead of summit with Xi
stories.summary: President Trump has arrived in Beijing ahead of a meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping. Trump has high-profile executives in the U.S. delegation with him, with trade and business on the agenda.

stories.title: Convicted of killing wife and son, Alex Murdaugh gets new trial due to jury tampering
stories.summary: The South Carolina Supreme court granted a new trial to former attorney Alex Murdaugh, who was convicted three years ago of killing his wife and son. The reason? Jury tampering.

stories.title: A severe mouse plague puts Australian crops in danger
stories.summary: Australia's grain farmers, already strained by war-driven shortages, now face a severe mouse plague that could devastate crops in a key growing region.

stories.title: Every World Cup puts a new spin on the soccer ball
stories.summary: Every World Cup, there's a new soccer ball. Sometimes the ball is panned. Sometimes people like it. Why do they keep changing it up? And what's notable about the ball in 2026?

stories.title: An astrophysicist's take on the government's UAP files: 'Just more fuzzy blob videos'
stories.summary: NPR's Scott Detrow talks with astrophysicist Adam Frank about the government's release of files related to Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena.

stories.title: Netflix goes to the movies
stories.summary: Netflix turned heads in Hollywood by giving Greta Gerwig's Narnia an exclusive theatrical release, a move that could signal a shift in the streamer's relationship with movie theaters.
